title: 第0003章 蓝河如血人心疯长第0004章 全村求雨人人心里长野草
lines: 打谷场上挤满了人。
平日里懒散的村民们，此刻都瞪大了眼睛，惊恐地看着村西头的那条河。
原本清澈的河水，此刻变成了浓稠的靛蓝色。那颜色深得发黑，像是一池子化不开的墨汁。河面上没有一丝波纹，静得像一面镜子，倒映着天上惨白的云彩。
“这是咋了？龙王爷发怒了？”
“屁！肯定是上游那个化工厂排的毒！”
“胡说！咱这深山老林的，哪来的化工厂！”
村民们议论纷纷，声音里透着恐慌。
村长王独活站在磨盘上，手里拿着个大喇叭，脸涨得通红：“都别吵吵！我已经派人去上游看了。说是……说是昨晚下了一场蓝雨，把山里的矿冲下来了。”
“蓝雨？谁见过蓝雨！”有人喊。
“就是！村长，这水还能喝吗？”
王独活眼珠子一转，大声说道：“咋不能喝？这是‘神仙水’！我刚才尝了一口，甜着呢！这是老天爷赏给咱们药王沟的福分！”
说着，他真的大勺舀了一碗蓝水，仰头就要喝。
“别喝！”
一声尖厉的喊声传来。人群自动分开一条道，雪见挤了进来。她脸色苍白，手里紧紧攥着那把铁锹。
“村长，这水有毒！”雪见指着河水，“你看那河边的草，都死了！”
众人顺着她指的方向看去，只见河岸边原本茂盛的野草，此刻全都枯萎发黑，像是被火烧过一样。
王独活的手僵在半空，那碗蓝水晃了晃，洒出来几滴，落在他的布鞋上，瞬间把鞋面染成了蓝色。
“雪见，你少在这妖言惑众！”王独活恼羞成怒，“这是矿物质！懂不懂？矿物质！”
“是不是矿物质，让狗试试就知道了。”雪见说完，吹了声口哨。
她家那条大黄狗从人群后钻出来，跑到河边，伸出舌头舔了一口蓝水。
仅仅过了几秒钟，大黄狗突然浑身抽搐，口吐白沫，发出一声凄厉的惨叫，然后直挺挺地倒在地上，四腿一蹬，死了。
全场死一般的寂静。
王独活手里的碗“啪”地一声摔在地上，摔得粉碎。
就在这时，人群中突然传来一阵骚动。
“快看！那是什么！”
众人转头看向河中心。只见蓝色的河面上，慢慢浮上来一个东西。
那是一具尸体。
尸体穿着红色的嫁衣，长发散开，像水草一样在蓝水中飘荡。最可怕的是，那尸体的脸，竟然和雪见长得一模一样！
“啊——！”有人尖叫起来。
雪见也愣住了，她死死盯着河里的尸体，双腿发软，差点瘫在地上。
那尸体缓缓睁开眼，那双眼睛不是黑的，而是蓝色的，像两颗蓝宝石，冷冷地盯着岸上的人群。
突然，尸体的嘴巴动了动，发出了声音。那声音不是从河里传来的，而是直接在每个人的脑海里响起的：
“还我……青黛……”
人群炸了锅，村民们尖叫着四散奔逃。
雪见没有跑。她看着河里的“自己”，突然想起昨晚儿子说的话——“我看见好多蓝色的蝴蝶”。
她低下头，看向自己的手背。不知什么时候，她的手背上，也浮现出了一道青色的叶脉纹路，正顺着血管，一点点往心脏蔓延。
远处的日头升起来了，照在蓝色的河面上，反射出诡异的光。药王沟的天，彻底变了。
“还我……青黛……”
那声音像无数根细密的冰针，顺着耳膜直直扎进脑髓里。岸上的村民们彻底炸了锅，哭爹喊娘的动静比刚才大黄狗死的时候还要凄惨十倍。有人连滚带爬地往村东头跑，有人直接吓瘫在泥地里，裤裆湿了一片。
雪见没跑。她像是被那河里的“自己”施了定身咒，双脚死死钉在原地。手背上那道青色的叶脉纹路正突突直跳，每跳一下，心脏就跟着抽痛一回，仿佛那河水里泡着的不是别人的尸体，而是她自己的心肝。
“都别跑！谁再跑老子崩了他！”
村长王独活从最初的惊恐中回过神来，他一把从腰间摸出那把用来防野猪的土铳，对着天上“砰”地开了一枪。
火药味瞬间冲散了那股令人作呕的腥甜气。村民们被枪声震得一愣，逃窜的脚步硬生生刹住了。
content_en:
The threshing floor was crowded with people.
The usually lazy villagers all stared at the river at the west end of the village with wide eyes at this moment.
The originally clear river water now turned into a thick indigo blue. The color was so dark that it looked like a pool of ink that couldn't be dissolved. There was no ripple on the river, it was as quiet as a mirror, reflecting the pale clouds in the sky.
"What's going on? The Dragon Prince is angry?"
"Shit! It must be the poison discharged from the chemical plant upstream!"
"Nonsense! How can we get a chemical factory in this deep mountain and forest!"
The villagers were talking among themselves, with panic in their voices.
The village chief, Wang Duhuo, stood on the millstone, holding a big horn in his hand, his face flushed: "Don't make any noise! I have sent people to look upstream. It is said... it was said that there was a blue rain last night, and the mines in the mountains were washed down."
"Lan Yu? Who has seen Lan Yu!" someone shouted.
"Yes! Village chief, can this water still be drunk?"
Wang Duhuo rolled his eyes and said loudly: "Why can't you drink it? This is 'fairy water'! I just took a sip and it was sweet! This is the blessing that God has given us Yaowanggou!"
As he spoke, he took a big ladle of blue water and raised his head to drink it.
"Don't drink!"
A shrill shout came. The crowd automatically separated into a lane, and Xuejian squeezed in. She looked pale and held the shovel tightly in her hand.
"Village chief, this water is poisonous!" Xuejian pointed to the river, "Look at the grass by the river, it's all dead!"
Everyone looked in the direction she pointed, and saw that the originally lush wild grass on the river bank was now withered and black, as if it had been burned by fire.
Wang Duhuo's hand froze in mid-air. The bowl of blue water swayed, and a few drops spilled out and fell on his cloth shoes, instantly dyeing the uppers blue.
"Xuejian, please stop confusing the public with your lies!" Wang Duhuo became angry, "This is minerals! Do you understand? Minerals!"
"Whether it's a mineral or not, just let the dog try it and you'll know." After Xuejian finished speaking, he whistled.
Her big yellow dog got out from behind the crowd, ran to the river, stuck out its tongue and took a sip of the blue water.
After only a few seconds, the big yellow dog suddenly twitched all over, foamed at the mouth, let out a shrill scream, and then fell straight to the ground, kicked off its legs, and died.
There was a deathly silence.
The bowl in Wang Duhuo's hand fell to the ground with a bang and shattered into pieces.
At this moment, there was a sudden commotion in the crowd.
"Look! What is that!"
Everyone turned to look at the center of the river. I saw something slowly floating on the blue river.
It was a corpse.
The corpse was wearing a red wedding dress, and its long hair was spread out, floating like water plants in the blue water. The most terrifying thing is that the face of the corpse looks exactly like Xuejian!
"Ah——!" someone screamed.
Xuejian was also stunned. She stared at the body in the river, her legs became weak and she almost collapsed on the ground.
The corpse slowly opened its eyes. The eyes were not black, but blue, like two sapphires, staring coldly at the crowd on the shore.
Suddenly, the corpse's mouth moved and made a sound. The voice didn't come from the river, but sounded directly in everyone's mind:
"Give me back...Qingdai..."
The crowd exploded, and the villagers ran away screaming.
Xuejian didn't run. She looked at "herself" in the river, and suddenly remembered what her son said last night - "I saw a lot of blue butterflies."
She lowered her head and looked at the back of her hand. At some point, a blue vein pattern appeared on the back of her hand, spreading along the blood vessels toward her heart.
The sun rose in the distance, shining on the blue river, reflecting a strange light. The sky in Yaowanggou has completely changed.
"Give me back...Qingdai..."
The sound was like countless fine ice needles, penetrating directly into the brain along the eardrums. The villagers on the shore were completely in a state of rage. Their cries for father and mother were ten times more miserable than when the big yellow dog died just now. Some people rolled on the ground and ran towards the east end of the village. Some people were so scared that they collapsed in the mud, their crotches soaked all over.
Xuejian didn’t run away. She seemed to have been cast a restraining spell by the "self" in the river, with her feet nailed to the spot. The green vein pattern on the back of her hand was beating rapidly, and every time it beat, her heart throbbed, as if what was soaking in the river was not someone else's corpse, but her own heart and liver.
"Don't run away! I'll kill anyone who runs again!"
The village chief Wang Duhuo recovered from his initial panic. He took out the gun used to guard against wild boars from his waist and fired a shot into the sky.
The smell of gunpowder instantly dissipated the sickly sweet smell. The villagers were stunned by the sound of gunfire, and their fleeing footsteps were stopped abruptly.
title_en: Chapter 0003 The Blue River is like blood and the hearts are growing wildly. Chapter 0004 The whole village is praying for rain and weeds are growing in everyone’s heart.
